leads.title: Smartphone Free Childhood: the unstoppable rise of a culture-shifting campaign
leads.summary: A campaign that has gained momentum in changing how families and society approach children and phones.

leads.title: People in Odisha's Babojola village sweep streets 3 times a day and fine those who litter
leads.summary: A teacher led Babojola village to adopt community cleanliness rules and basic waste infrastructure.

leads.title: This 16-YO's 'Glow Guide' answers the questions burn and acid attack survivors face after hospital
leads.summary: A 16-year-old from Pune wrote a 60-page guide on everyday skin, hair, clothing and self-care for burn and acid attack survivors.
